A bead of sweat runs down his forehead. His mouth twitches, and barely moving his lips he whispers: "It's here." A low subsonic hum vibrates under the silence. No on-screen text, captions, subtitles or logos. Shot on 35mm film in 1991, heavy grain, dim practical light, still and deliberate camera, deadpan and serious, an art-house horror film in the vein of David Lynch.
